name: p12_forward_acceleration_lookahead
title: Biohub P12 Forward Acceleration
purpose: One-factor P9 coupled-division A/B: add a bounded three-frame forward-acceleration bonus only inside the existing motion-relink assignment cost. Every already-admissible t->t+1 candidate searches physical t+2 continuations with next-step distance <=10 um; its minimum acceleration residual receives a linear bonus from 0.20 at 0 um to 0 at 4 um. Detector, checkpoints, learned and harmonic association probabilities, candidate gates, Hungarian passes, ILP, gap repair, DeepCenter, short-track policy, linefit, coupled divisions, caps, datasets, and submission format remain exactly P9. No launch or submission is performed by this spec.

public_source.rule: For each geometrically admissible source-target edge, scan t+2 nodes with next-step distance <=10 um, take the minimum velocity-difference norm, and subtract 0.20*max(0,1-residual/4.0) from assignment cost.
public_source.isolation_warning: The public notebook carries additional ranker, edge-TTA, gap2, and shared-budget mechanisms. Its leaderboard position is evidence for mechanism plausibility, not an isolated causal delta for this rule.

provenance.independent_public_observation: The 2026-08-17 competitive refresh found the same three-frame acceleration motif in three public 0.915-to-0.918-era notebooks, but those stacks also contained other changes. P12 therefore tests the rule atomically rather than importing their claimed delta.
provenance.routes_on: physical node coordinates and time only; no dataset, crop, acquisition, hidden label, image content, or ground truth routing
provenance.interaction_warning: The bonus is small (<=0.20 cost units) but can change Hungarian assignments, which can change downstream gaps and coupled-division orphan topology. Those are consequences of the single assignment-cost treatment, not separately tuned edits.
provenance.frozen_controls: P9 datasets, weights, detector threshold/TTA, harmonic lambda, dual-seed state, motion gates and velocity weight, learned bonus, DeepCenter epoch 500, gap rules, linefit, 8/11/10 coupled-division geometry, 2.25 divergence, caps, and all output invariants are unchanged.
